meaning: ST I q.4 a.2 co., first proof, for the prima via's mover: it is the maximal being, which causes the being of every other being, and the perfections of an effect pre-exist in its cause; so it has every perfection found in things. The Comparator config also verifies everyRespectNotDerived: the strong #166 bridge STMT-FIRST-UNMOVED-MOVER-HAS-EVERY-PERFECTION (act in every respect) does not follow, since a respect no being has is lacking to the first mover too.
